## Game Releases

### God of War Laufey releases February 16, 2027, with sequel already in development
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Sony Santa Monica Studio confirmed at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 that God of War Laufey launches February 16, 2027 exclusively on PlayStation 5, shipping with a physical disc ahead of Sony's 2028 all-digital transition. The game stars Deborah Ann Woll as Laufey (formerly Faye), Kratos's late Norse wife, marking the first mainline entry without Kratos as protagonist, set in an afterlife realm called the Everywhen. Franchise creative head Cory Barlog confirmed a separate, already-in-development Kratos-led sequel that connects directly to Laufey's story, with February 2027 also hosting Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, Persona 4 Revival, Fable, and Metro 2039.
